records.name: Bonanza Falls / Greenwood Falls
records.title: Seasonal township visitor area; waterfall parcels differ
records.summary: Carp Lake Township documents managing the Bonanza Falls visitor entrance, parking, signs and facilities. The regional waterfall marker falls within a parcel attributed to the township, but Michigan GIS waterfall #124 about 168 metres away intersects a parcel recorded to a private LLC. Only the signed township visitor approach is supported; unrestricted riverbank or private-parcel access is not.
records.guidance: Use only the signed Bonanza/Greenwood Falls township entrance from M-64 during its visitor season. The township documented no RV, oversized vehicle or overnight camping restrictions under consideration; check posted signs. Do not navigate to the GIS falls point, cross unmarked property boundaries, or assume the area is open in late October/winter.
records.locationNotes: Michigan GIS #124 (46.818863,-89.571458); regional Western U.P. brochure (46.817719,-89.570023); locations about 168 m apart, not interchangeable. Parcel ownership display is not a title search or easement determination.

records.reviewLimitations: Carp Lake Township 2025 board minutes document paid replacement signage, parking/turnaround expansion discussion, visitor facilities and seasonal closure. October 2025 minutes anticipated closing by end of that month; December 2025 minutes confirmed closure until spring 2026. Neither establishes the 2026 closing date. Parcel overlay identifies two different ownership labels, but is not a legal easement, title or trail survey.
records.nextEvidence: Official lot-to-public-view route and boundary against parcel data; current season gate/closure signs. Do not public-index full falls guide until lawful viewing route is independently matched to the municipal visitor site.
